notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This small update aims to fix a functionality that I hadn't anticipated (haha) based on feedback. 
Changes:
[list]
[*] Gameplay update to prevent carrying the rock all the way to the top haha
[/list]
This update comes from observing the behavior of some players carrying the rock to the top instead of rolling it up the mountain, breaking the gameplay; however, this was allowed due to a bug in the game code that permitted hand rotation, allowing the rock to be held. Now, this is no longer posible. Nevertheless, I will keep an eye on you and check for any feedback!

Thanks to the first players, specially to coo1red and to わかやみ. Thank you so much for your support, I hope you give it another try haha

See you soon, 

Carlos V.
